# ZeroZ4j

> An experimental pure-Java full-stack framework (version 0.8.0). The UI is Java compiled for the
> browser by TeaVM, client and server communicate over a binary RPC protocol on a persistent
> WebSocket, and the server persists the JVM object graph with ZeroZ DB over EclipseStore. You write no
> JavaScript, JSON, REST routes or SQL.

Key things to know before generating ZeroZ Stack code:

- Consume from Maven Central: import `com.zeroz4j:zerozstack-bom:0.8.0` and depend on
  `zerozstack-server-core`, `zerozstack-client`, `zerozstack-shared-api`, `zerozstack-ui-components`
  and `zerozstack-store-eclipsestore` without versions.
- To build the framework itself, requires JDK 21 and `mvn clean install -DskipTests` from the repository root; the `clean` is
  required because each example server's `target/libs` is never pruned.
- An application has three modules: shared (`@DataModel` models, `@RmiService` interfaces), client
  (UI), server (`@ApplicationScoped` CDI implementations).
- A `@DataModel` may be a class, a `record`, or a `sealed` interface or abstract class listing its
  permitted types (records and sealed types both 0.8.0+). A record cannot be `@LiveSync`,
  `@ClientWritable`, part of a reference cycle, or a persistence root; use a class for those. A model
  may extend another model and the base's fields travel too (0.8.0+).
- The client compiles to JavaScript via TeaVM today. This is a deliberate interim choice because
  TeaVM's WasmGC backend is not yet complete enough for ZeroZ Stack; WasmGC remains the intended
  destination. Do not claim client code compiles to WebAssembly today, and do not change the
  JAVASCRIPT target.
- Do not wrap client event handlers in your own thread. `Component.addDomEventListener` already runs
  handler bodies on a suspendable TeaVM green thread, which is why a suspending RMI call works directly
  inside one.
- Choosing between local signals, RMI, server events, shared signals and LiveSync is the framework's
  hardest decision and its most common source of bugs. Read the decision guide before generating
  state-propagation code.
- Persistence is transactional. Inject `ZeroZDbNode` and send a `DbCommand`: everything it enlists
  commits atomically. `zeroz4j.store.mode` = EMBEDDED | AUTO_SERVER | CLIENT selects where the data
  lives without changing application code. Commands and queries must be plain classes, never
  records.
- Many failure modes are silent rather than exceptional. Read the troubleshooting page.
- The server accepts messages up to 4 MB (`zeroz.ws.maxBinaryMessageBytes`), and a bigger one closes
  the connection rather than raising an error. Never put file contents in an RMI argument: use the
  `FileUpload` component and a `FileUploadHandler` bean, which move files over their own HTTP address.
- A client may edit, re-read or lock only what the server actually sent it. Every object a live
  change reaches needs its own `@ClientWritable`, not just the outermost one.
- An unexpected server exception reaches the client as one sentence and a reference code. Throw
  `com.zeroz4j.server.ClientVisibleException` when the caller should read the real message.
- Never empty a container by hand. `getElement().setInnerHTML("")` leaves the old screen's timers and
  effects running. Use `replaceContents(...)`, `removeAll()` or `remove(...)`, all of which run
  `onDetach` on everything leaving (0.8.0+).
- Ask for a text size by name from `TextStyle` (`PAGE_TITLE`, `SECTION_TITLE`, `BODY`, `SECONDARY`,
  `CAPTION`) rather than writing out sizes and fades. How loud is a separate question, `Emphasis`
  (`FULL`, `QUIET`, `FAINT`), given only where the text disagrees with its size. Text drawn inside a
  chart uses `PlotText` (`FIGURE`, `LABEL`, `CAPTION`, `MESSAGE`), because class names do not reach a
  drawing.
- Name every form field with `withLabel("...")`, not with the constructor argument — the constructor
  argument is the placeholder, which disappears the moment somebody types. Anything clickable must be
  a `Button` or a `Link` with a real `href`, never a click listener on a `Div`.
- Test a server in-process with `zerozstack-server-test` (test scope): `TestServer.builder().beans(...)
  .start()` and `server.connect(user, roles)`. Two servers can run side by side.
- **This page describes the framework's main line.** An application depends on one released version,
  which may be older. The rules for that exact version travel inside its own jars, at
  `META-INF/zeroz4j/AGENTS.md` in `zerozstack-shared-api`, and a project generated from the archetype
  carries its own `AGENTS.md` naming its version. Prefer those when they disagree with this.

## Decision guides

- [Choosing how state moves](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/decide/index.md): The decision procedure for all five state-propagation mechanisms. Start here.
- [Events, signals or LiveSync?](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/decide/events-vs-signals-vs-livesync.md): Full comparison with worked examples, and the honest limits of each. Includes the facts that decide most cases: events and LiveSync can be scoped to a user or session while shared signals cannot, and a live object is itself a reactive dependency.
- [RMI or state sync?](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/decide/rmi-vs-state-sync.md): State edits sync, operations call. Why operations deserve a named method.
- [Local or shared signal?](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/decide/local-vs-shared-signal.md): When state should cross the wire at all. Shared signals are JVM-global.
- [Anti-patterns](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/decide/antipatterns.md): Named failure modes and their fixes, including event-as-state, operation-as-edit and unbounded broadcast.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/start/quickstart.md): Prerequisites, build, run an example, and which examples need dev login credentials. Build and run commands executed against main.
- [Examples](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/examples/index.md): What each example application demonstrates and why that mechanism. The examples are the most reliable specification of current usage.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/troubleshooting.md): Symptom-first, covering the silent failures. Read this when nothing happens.

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/reference/glossary.md): Event, signal, push, message, sync, mutation, handle, retained value — defined once, not interchangeable.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/reference/limitations.md): Every known gap in 0.8.0, including features that are declared but not implemented.
- [Wire protocol](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md): Frame structure, opcodes and type tags.
- [Validation](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): Annotate once on the model; enforced by the client binder and independently by the server.

## Guides

- [Declaring the types that cross the wire](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/data-models.md): When to write a class, a record or a sealed family; sharing fields with a base class; which field types are allowed.
- [Testing an application](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/testing.md): Starting a server inside a test in one process, driving it, and giving one server settings of its own.
- [Signals](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/SIGNALS.md): ValueSignal, Computed, Effect, shared signals, the immutability contract, lifecycle.
- [Server events](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/SERVER_EVENTS.md): EventTopic, EventPublisher, ServerEvents, delivery semantics.
- [LiveSync](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/LIVESYNC.md): Two-way object synchronization, @ClientWritable gates, LiveMutationListener.
- [UI components](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/UI_COMPONENTS.md): Layouts, the component catalog, naming a field, the five named text sizes, swapping what is inside a container.
- [Forms and binding](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/ui-forms-and-validation.md): Captioning a field, Binder, and where a failed check's sentence appears.
- [Keyboard and naming](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/ui-keyboard-and-naming.md): What every control owes somebody with no mouse, and what the build check does and does not enforce.
- [Stacking overlays](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/ui-layering.md): The named Layer scale, and the browser's top layer that no number can beat.
- [Accepting file uploads](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/file-uploads.md): The FileUpload component, the FileUploadHandler bean, the size limit and what the application must check itself.
- [Authentication and authorization](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/security-auth.md): AuthenticationProvider, @Secured, @RolesAllowed, client identity without a login, and which connections are accepted.
- [Packaging and running](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/guides/packaging.md): The four shapes a server ships in, and every zeroz.* setting with its default.

## For coding agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Build commands, module map, non-negotiable rules, the decision procedure and the silent-failure table, compressed.
- [Agent prompts](https://github.com/ZeroZ4j/zerozstack/blob/main/docs/AGENT_PROMPTS.md): Ready-to-paste task specifications for building ZeroZ Stack applications.
